leaked_early.details: FT Alphaville reported on May 30, 2014 that Shire was holding internal discussions regarding a possible offer for NPS; NPS issued an SEC filing on June 2, 2014 to 'dispel erroneous press reports' stating no communication with Shire had occurred.

notes: The deal was driven by the upcoming PDUFA date for Natpara, with Shire assuming the full FDA regulatory risk; the company ran a limited market check of nine parties after receiving Shire's best and final offer, but all declined.
